definitions.gloss: processed goods; manufactured product; processed item
definitions.explanation: A product that has been modified or transformed from its raw or natural state through manufacturing, refining, or other processing methods. Commonly refers to processed foods, but also applies to industrial products.

examples.japanese: {加工品|かこうひん}の{原材料|げんざいりょう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: To check the raw materials of a processed product.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{農産物|のうさんぶつ}の{加工品|かこうひん}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This region is famous for its processed agricultural products.

examples.japanese: {食品|しょくひん}{加工品|かこうひん}には{添加物|てんかぶつ}が{含|ふく}まれていることが{多|おお}いので、{表示|ひょうじ}をよく{読|よ}んだほうがいい。
examples.english: Processed food products often contain additives, so it's better to read the labels carefully.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in food-related contexts. {加工|かこう}{食品|しょくひん} (processed food) is a near-synonym but focuses specifically on food, while {加工品|かこうひん} can refer to any processed item.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食品|しょくひん}{加工品|かこうひん} (processed food products)
- {農産|のうさん}{加工品|かこうひん} (processed agricultural products)
- {水産|すいさん}{加工品|かこうひん} (processed marine products)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {加工|かこう}{食品|しょくひん}: processed food — specifically food that has been processed
- {製品|せいひん}: product, manufactured goods — broader term for any commercially made item
